messages:
chandra: Quick recap from the latency postmortem this morning — recurring nightly tail at ~02:45-03:10 UTC, cache miss storms around checkpoint windows, and uneven batching on a handful of GPU pods. Need to assign owners for remediation + a short SLO plan we can ship to ops/legal if needed.

chandra: Proposed quick actions: 
• T1: Surface KV miss-rate heatmap + TTL churn curve (owner?)
• T2: Per-pod batch-size distribution + hot-pod alert (owner?)
• T3: Temporary SLO holding plan + customer advisory draft (who owns CR?)
• T4: Canary rollback + runbook update + one dry-run drill (owner?, drill window)
• T5: Investigate checkpoint scheduling overlap + stagger plan (owner?)

jas: I'll take T1. Plan: add a daily and 72h heatmap, TTL churn percentiles, and a sampled key tracer to avoid cardinality. Targeting 2026-04-06 for dashboards + PR.

lucas: I'll own T2. I'll export batch_size histogram to Prom and build a Grafana panel. Propose alert: sustained p95 batch_size > 70 for 10m on any pod -> page SRE and slack #eng-sre. ETA 2026-03-31.

nina: For T3 (SLO holding): current infra p99 SLO = `100ms` for server-side inference. We consumed ~28% of error budget this month due to the nightly spikes. Suggest a rollback-safe holding plan: increase p99 to `130ms` for max 10 days, annotate the SLA tracker and open a customer advisory only if we expect >5% customer impact. I can draft the CR + advisory. Who routes to legal?

sam: ops usually routes legal signoff; ping me when the CR is ready. Also recommend adding a dashboard banner and a verification checklist in Redwood Console before any SLA text change.

jas: small note: KV sampling should attach a low-cardinality label like `shard_group` to help aggregation. I'll include retention knobs.

lucas: alert rule draft snippet: ```alert: HotPodBatching
expr: histogram_quantile(0.95, sum(rate(model_batch_size_bucket[5m])) by (le, pod)) > 70
for: 10m
labels:
  severity: page
annotations:
  summary: "Pod {{ $labels.pod }} has sustained large batch sizes"
```

nina: For the advisory: I'll put a short note for customers emphasizing actions we're taking (metrics, stagger checkpoints, temporary SLO holding) and share a candidate email in this thread by EOD.

incident-bot: Ticket created: REDW-4233 - "Nightly latency spike remediation: KV metrics, batching, SLO holding, checkpoint staggering" https://redwood.internal/tickets/REDW-4233

chandra: Linking REDW-4233. Assignments so far: T1 jas (2026-04-06), T2 lucas (2026-03-31), T3 nina draft (2026-03-25), T4 sam ops drill coordination (2026-03-29), T5 lucas infra ticket for stagger (ETA 2026-04-05).

jas: I'll also add a KV prewarm experiment as a follow-on subtask in REDW-4233.

lucas: For T5 I replayed the nightly workload with checkpoint staggering and saw ~35% p99 improvement on affected pods. I'll open infra ticket INFRA-1785 to schedule stagger by shard and link it in REDW-4233.

sam: Drill suggestion: runbook dry-run on Tue 02:30-03:15 UTC, oncall + op leads. I can coordinate the pager window.

chandra: OK — next sync/check-in in #eng-sre 2026-03-26 15:00 UTC to confirm dashboard links and CR draft. If anything slips, update REDW-4233 and ping @sam. :rocket:

jas: noted.

nina: I'll post the advisory draft here when ready.

lucas: adding Grafana panel link to REDW-4233 shortly with queries and panel screenshots.

chandra: Thanks all — please keep updates in the ticket. Closing loop here."
